archetype: Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy) - blended with modern editorial web trends.
philosophy: Education requires trust, calm, and growth. Avoid generic 'edtech' vectors. Use human-centered visuals, spacious bento layouts, generous spacing, and sophisticated typography. Asymmetry creates interest.

rules.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-bold text-[#1C211F] leading-tight
rules.note: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans. Do not center everything. Left-align dense text.

components_strategy.button_primary: bg-[#0F4C3A] text-white rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-semibold transition-all hover:-translate-y-1 hover:bg-[#0A3B2C] shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl flex items-center justify-center
components_strategy.button_secondary: bg-white text-[#1C211F] border border-[#E2E8F0] rounded-full px-8 py-4 font-semibold transition-all hover:bg-[#F9F8F6] hover:text-[#0F4C3A]
components_strategy.card: bg-white rounded-3xl p-8 border border-gray-100 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.04)] hover:shadow-[0_16px_48px_rgba(0,0,0,0.08)] transition-all duration-300
components_strategy.input: rounded-xl border-gray-200 bg-[#F9F8F6] px-4 py-3 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#0F4C3A] focus:bg-white outline-none transition-all w-full

hero_image.description: Hero section background or side image: Diverse young student learning from mentor in natural light.

category_abstract_bg.description: Use as a subtle decorative background image inside the bento grid cards for subject categories.

section_specific_rules.header: Sticky nav using 'glass_surface' styling. Must include logo, nav links (desktop visible), and secondary CTA.
section_specific_rules.hero: Asymmetric layout. Left side: Heavy typography (H1), overline 'ELEVATE YOUR LEARNING', and CTA 'Find Your Tutor Now'. Right side: Overlapping cards with the hero_image, utilizing negative space. Max overlay bg-black/30 if image is a background.
section_specific_rules.subject_categories: Bento Grid (Mode A). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8. Wide gaps (gap-8). Mix tall, square, and wide cards. Use abstract geometric shapes as backgrounds inside these cards. Subjects: Math, Science, English, Coding.
section_specific_rules.tutor_profiles: Clean editorial layout. Grid of large, rounded-3xl cards. Show image, name, subjects, rating, and a 'Book Session' CTA. Use pure HTML/Tailwind for structural cards, avoid generic Shadcn card if it restricts asymmetry.
section_specific_rules.booking_payment: Use Shadcn components heavily customized to match the brand. Clean, form-centric, using the '#F9F8F6' background to contrast against white cards.
section_specific_rules.testimonials: Use generous spacing. Large quotes (text-2xl) paired with small user avatars from testimonial_portraits.
section_specific_rules.faq: Accordion style using Shadcn, but remove default borders and use background color changes on hover.
section_specific_rules.footer: Massive spacing (py-32). Dark theme flip for footer (bg-[#0F4C3A] text-white). Large 'Let's Talk' or 'Start Learning' CTA.

motion.rules: Staggered fade-up for grid items. Subtle parallax on hero image. Interactions must feel weighty and premium, not fast/frenetic.

testing.requirements: MUST add 'data-testid' to ALL interactive elements. Example: data-testid='find-tutor-now-cta', data-testid='book-tutor-button', data-testid='category-card-math'.
